description: This file defines a generic linked list data structure with classes for nodes, iterators, and different list types (HLL and SLL). It includes class templates, memory management, and list operations.

classes.name: NodeLinks
classes.description: Base class providing next and previous node pointers for linked list nodes.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the linked list, containing data and owner reference.

classes.name: LinkedListIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing linked list nodes.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: Base class for a generic linked list, managing node connections and size.

classes.name: HLL
classes.description: Derived class representing a specific linked list type, supporting add operations with memory management.

classes.name: SLL
classes.description: Derived class representing a singly linked list type, supporting add operations with memory management.

methods.name: addFront
methods.description: Adds an element to the front of the list (HLL and SLL classes).

methods.name: addBack
methods.description: Adds an element to the back of the list (HLL and SLL classes).
